nf42d5c901b.headline: Sensex crashes over 1,700 points, Nifty below 16,850: What led to today's market fall
nf42d5c901b.summary: Indian equity indices plunged on Monday, with the BSE Sensex falling nearly 1,750 points. The sell-off was heavy and spread across sectors.
nf42d5c901b.why: The BSE Sensex is India's benchmark index of 30 large listed companies, so sharp falls signal broad pressure on the country's equity market.

impacts.name: BSE Sensex
impacts.why: The benchmark index fell nearly 1,750 points in heavy trading across sectors.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

nf42d5c901b.why_moved: The input reports a heavy sell-off across sectors on Monday, with the Sensex down nearly 1,750 points and the Nifty below 16,850.

n8443d96218.headline: Exclusive-Greece to repay last IMF loans by March, achieve primary surplus in 2023-Finance Minister
n8443d96218.summary: Greece will repay the final tranches of bailout loans owed to the IMF by the end of March, two years ahead of schedule. It aims for a primary surplus in 2023, according to its finance minister.
n8443d96218.why: Repaying IMF loans reduces Greece's external debt obligations and signals improved fiscal standing for its sovereign bonds.

n4975baa152.headline: Petrol and diesel prices hit record high levels
n4975baa152.summary: Petrol and diesel prices in the UK have reached record levels, with no sign of prices falling. Motorists are facing further pressure from the cost of living crisis.
n4975baa152.why: Fuel prices feed into inflation, household spending and transport costs, which matter for UK consumer-facing and energy-linked investments.

nc6372d4080.headline: Himalaya yogi ran India's top bourse as puppet master, regulator says
nc6372d4080.summary: A probe by India's market regulator found the former head of the National Stock Exchange shared confidential information with a yogi and sought his advice on crucial decisions. The findings were reported ahead of further action.
nc6372d4080.why: The National Stock Exchange is India's largest stock exchange, and governance lapses there draw close investor and regulatory scrutiny.

n1dcc9b9e50.headline: PharmaCielo to supply Germany with cannabis products from Colombia
n1dcc9b9e50.summary: Toronto-headquartered PharmaCielo says it will start sending THC-dominant cannabis products from Colombia to Germany by the end of the year.
n1dcc9b9e50.why: PharmaCielo is a Canadian cannabis producer with Colombian cultivation, and its export deals reflect the growing European medical cannabis market.

n899dde446e.headline: Ukraine vows to keep airspace open despite tensions
n899dde446e.summary: Ukraine says it will keep its airspace open and promises financial support for airlines, as fears grow that more carriers, after KLM, may avoid the country.
n899dde446e.why: Airspace closures and airline avoidance raise costs and disrupt routes for carriers such as Air France-KLM, which are sensitive to geopolitical risk in Eastern Europe.

nd98a42904a.headline: Nigeria turns to Europe for rail loans as China talks hit dead end
nd98a42904a.summary: China is hesitating to make new loans to Nigeria as debt servicing costs rise, pushing Nigeria to seek rail financing from Europe.
nd98a42904a.why: Rail financing decisions shape infrastructure investment and Nigeria's external debt burden, which matters for sovereign credit assessments.

n0ebbdd6bcf.headline: 1,000 jobs at risk as Studio Retail set to call in administrators
n0ebbdd6bcf.summary: Studio Retail, a large East Lancashire company, is set to appoint administrators, putting around 1,000 jobs at risk. The report describes the company as a large East Lancashire business.
n0ebbdd6bcf.why: Studio Retail is a UK clothing and homewares retailer, so administration affects its store network, suppliers and employment.

n7dcd460a63.headline: Buy now, pay later firms making contract terms fairer and easier to understand
n7dcd460a63.summary: The Financial Conduct Authority said it was concerned about a potential risk of harm to consumers from how buy now, pay later contract terms were drafted. The firms are working to address it.
n7dcd460a63.why: The FCA is the UK's conduct regulator for financial firms, and buy now, pay later lenders are subject to its consumer credit rules. Regulatory changes can affect the business models and profitability of these lenders.

nbc35cbcd69.headline: 150 new jobs announced as Irish firm secures contracts in utilities sector
nbc35cbcd69.summary: An Irish firm has secured contracts in the utilities sector, with 150 new jobs announced.
nbc35cbcd69.why: Contract wins in utilities can signal demand for infrastructure services in Ireland's energy and water networks.

nf446d2e728.headline: Audioboom shares balloon following Spotify and Amazon takeover reports
nf446d2e728.summary: Audioboom Group PLC shares increased following reports of potential takeover interest from Spotify Technology SA and Amazon.com Inc.
nf446d2e728.why: Audioboom is a digital audio company, and takeover interest from major streaming platforms Spotify and Amazon signals consolidation trends in the audio streaming and podcasting sector.
nf446d2e728.why_moved: Reports of potential takeovers by Spotify and Amazon led to investor optimism, driving Audioboom shares higher.

nf709ff87f1.headline: Mike Ashley-backed Studio Retail Group to file for administration
nf709ff87f1.summary: The online retail business Studio Retail Group, formerly Findel, has had its shares suspended on the London Stock Exchange and is set to file for administration.
nf709ff87f1.why: Studio Retail Group is a publicly traded UK online retailer; its administration filing signals financial distress impacting shareholders and creditors.
nf709ff87f1.why_moved: The administration filing and share suspension directly affect investor confidence and trading in Studio Retail Group shares.

nd3fb9586a3.headline: Monday blues for Market! Sensex nosedives 1,747 pts, Nifty loses 17K mark
nd3fb9586a3.summary: Indian stock indices declined sharply due to global market weakness and geopolitical tensions.
nd3fb9586a3.why: Market declines reflect investor concerns over global risks and economic outlook, affecting capital flows.

n85ad5fd1a0.headline: World Bank temporarily relocates staff from Ukraine - internal memo | The Jerusalem Post
n85ad5fd1a0.summary: The World Bank is monitoring the Ukraine border situation and has moved staff due to rising tensions with Russia.
n85ad5fd1a0.why: The geopolitical risk in Ukraine could disrupt regional economic stability and development projects.

n418671faf9.headline: These 3 ASX 200 shares are topping the volume charts on Monday
n418671faf9.summary: Several ASX 200 shares are topping volume charts, indicating increased trading activity in Australian equities.
n418671faf9.why: High trading volume can signal investor interest or market volatility in Australian stocks.

nc0270d246d.headline: Lake Resources fast-tracks lithium expansion strategy in Argentina
nc0270d246d.summary: Lake Resources plans to fast-track its lithium projects in Argentina, aiming for 100,000 tonnes per annum capacity.
nc0270d246d.why: Lithium is critical for EV batteries, and expansion impacts supply chains and commodity markets.

na168b8997a.headline: Why are Israeli hi-tech companies bracing for conflict in Ukraine? | The Jerusalem Post
na168b8997a.summary: Israeli hi-tech companies relying on Ukrainian teams may experience disruptions due to the ongoing conflict, impacting their operations.
na168b8997a.why: Israeli tech firms are significant players in innovation and exports, and disruptions could affect regional and global tech supply chains.

n2de71321e8.headline: Inox Wind stock plummets 8% as Q3 loss widens on poor revenues
n2de71321e8.summary: Inox Wind's shares declined amid widening losses and revenue challenges in Q3, reflecting sector headwinds.
n2de71321e8.why: Company performance impacts investor confidence and sector outlook in renewable energy manufacturing.

n1b6d9a9c34.headline: GeoJunxion announces the closing of a series of location intelligence service agreements for a value of almost 100K Euro and the renewal of an important service contract for a value of over 230K Euro
n1b6d9a9c34.summary: GeoJunxion closes contracts for location intelligence services with two global tech companies, valued at approximately €100K.
n1b6d9a9c34.why: Service agreements with tech firms can influence revenue streams and growth prospects for the company.

n88d0e96f2a.headline: Indian rupee plunges against UAE dirham as dollar demand grows amid Russia-Ukraine tension
n88d0e96f2a.summary: The rupee weakened against the UAE dirham due to increased dollar demand and Russia-Ukraine tensions.
n88d0e96f2a.why: Currency fluctuations impact trade, inflation, and capital flows in India and its foreign exchange markets.

n799431ab79.headline: UK employers plan biggest pay rises in nearly 10 years amid surging inflation
n799431ab79.summary: UK companies are planning pay increases of around 3%, though still below rising inflation rates.
n799431ab79.why: Wage growth impacts consumer spending, inflation, and corporate profitability in the UK economy.

n3e5ca76642.headline: PML-Q assures PM Imran Khan of support amid Opposition row
n3e5ca76642.summary: PML-Q assures support to Prime Minister Imran Khan amidst opposition disputes, affecting political stability.
n3e5ca76642.why: Political stability in Pakistan can influence economic policies, foreign investment, and regional trade dynamics.

n5eab775807.headline: Japan's Kirin brewery to withdraw from Myanmar
n5eab775807.summary: Japanese drinks company Kirin announced its withdrawal from Myanmar following a failed bid to disentangle from a junta-linked joint venture.
n5eab775807.why: This move highlights geopolitical and regulatory risks impacting foreign companies in Myanmar.

n278d76cc09.headline: Kenya is considering using a central bank digital currency
n278d76cc09.summary: The Central Bank of Kenya is assessing the applicability of a CBDC, indicating potential adoption to improve real-time payments.
n278d76cc09.why: A CBDC could modernize Kenya's payment infrastructure, impacting financial inclusion and monetary policy effectiveness.

n1cc51ea420.headline: Fitch Affirms Georgia at 'BB'; Outlook Stable
n1cc51ea420.summary: Fitch Ratings has affirmed Georgia's credit rating at 'BB' with a stable outlook, reflecting its economic stability.
n1cc51ea420.why: Credit ratings influence foreign investment and borrowing costs, impacting Georgia's economic prospects.

n7464069b4a.headline: US stocks close down on Russia-Ukraine tensions, inflation woes
n7464069b4a.summary: US equities closed lower as investors reacted to geopolitical tensions and inflation worries, influencing market sentiment.
n7464069b4a.why: Market declines reflect investor concerns over geopolitical risks and inflation, affecting global financial markets.

n15a6a80342.headline: Anger in Scotland as Keir Starmer says
n15a6a80342.summary: Keir Starmer states there is no case for rejoining the EU amid reports of plummeting UK trade with European neighbors.
n15a6a80342.why: Trade relations with Europe are vital for the UK economy, affecting exports, imports, and currency movements.

n548bd616a9.headline: ‘Very Robust Growth:' CEO of Singapore's Largest Bank Says 2021 Was One of the Best Years
n548bd616a9.summary: The bank reported a 44% increase in full-year net profit, reaching 6.8 billion Singapore dollars.
n548bd616a9.why: Strong earnings from Singapore's largest bank reflect robust financial sector performance and economic recovery.

n0f117abac7.headline: StanChart, Heritage to pay Sh7.7bn for Arror dam scandal
n0f117abac7.summary: Kenyan authorities seek Sh7.7 billion from Heritage Insurance and Standard Chartered Bank related to guarantees for the controversial Arror and Kimwarer dams.
n0f117abac7.why: The case involves significant financial liabilities for the banks and insurance companies, with potential implications for regional infrastructure projects.

n79422ad824.headline: Risk of Russian attack on Ukraine hits the zloty. Strong volatility returns
n79422ad824.summary: The zloty's volatility was exceptionally high over the past week. EUR/PLN fell to 4.48 after the Monetary Policy Council meeting but rose about 10 groszy on Russia-Ukraine tension concerns.
n79422ad824.why: The Polish zloty is the currency of Poland, and its moves against the euro reflect both domestic monetary policy and regional geopolitical risk.
